def charge(self, customer_id, cents):
    invoice = {"customer_id": customer_id, "cents": cents}
    policy = self.policy_provider.get_policy(invoice)
    last_error = None
    for attempt in range(policy.max_attempts):
        try:

        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc
            if attempt < policy.max_attempts - 1:
                delay = policy.initial_delay_seconds * (policy.backoff_multiplier ** attempt)
                time.sleep(delay)
